historical_record.description: A building contract was recorded for a three-storey frame building of apartments, all work except glazing, lath and plaster, plumbing, electric wiring, heating, wall beds, finish hardware, lighting fixtures and window shades, at $8,958. M. Mattanovich was named as architect and V. Filippis as contractor.
A permit was sought for repairs: the tar and gravel roof repaired, with painting and tinting, for apartments, estimated at $900. Chas. Coburn was named as contractor.
